## Issue Links
<!--
Use these patterns so maintainers know the status of linked issues:
- Use "Closes #123" only when this PR fully resolves the issue.
- Use "#123" (no keyword) when the PR is related but does not close the issue.
- One PR may close multiple issues by listing multiple "Closes #…" lines.
- Do not use "Closes" for partial work; prefer plain references instead.
Example:
Closes #123
#456
